notes: MAUI displays default time as '12:00 AM' (12-hour format with AM/PM); C++ displays '0:00' (24-hour format) — the device locale / time format is not being respected

This format mismatch affects every time_picker row: Default, BackgroundColor, Background, Disabled, TextColor, Format, IsFocused, IsFocused False, Set to null all show '12:00 AM' in MAUI vs '0:00' in C++

Background color rows (blue/green/teal tinted pickers) and the TextColor tinted row appear structurally similar between both; the format string is correct ('12:0' format row shows '12:00' on MAUI vs '12:0' on C++)
Dark mode has the same 12h vs 24h discrepancy throughout; this is the same device-locale date/time default issue documented in memory as a known latent bug
